A '''[[Cloning/Legends|clone]]''' was stationed in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this clone was working in the detention facility's cremation center.<ref name="Deception" />

After the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] along with prisoners [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] started a prison riot in the mess hall, they managed to evade the prison [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|guards]] and used the morgue to escape, hiding inside caskets which were sent to the cremation center. This clone along with three others were working in the cremation center when the incident happened, and started checking the caskets after a [[Unidentified clone (cremation center)|fellow clone]] detected life signs. When he opened the caskets, the prisoners inside jumped out and started attacking the other clones. One clone grabbed his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and tried to shoot Cad Bane, but he managed to grab this clone and used him as a shield, blocking the other one's shots.<ref name="Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the series.
